Generative AI is a branch of artificial intelligence that creates new content—whether text, images, audio, video, or other data—rather than just analyzing or classifying existing information. By learning patterns from large datasets, generative models can produce realistic, novel outputs that mimic the style or structure of the training material. Examples include language models that write essays, image generators that produce artwork, and music models that compose new tunes.

Generative AI’s most common applications span a wide range of industries and creative fields.
